name: Trust in Automation questionnaire (Körber)
citation: Körber, M. (2019). Theoretical considerations and development of a questionnaire to measure trust in automation. In Proc. IEA 2018, AISC 823 (pp. 13–30). Springer.
license: CC BY-SA 4.0 (per the author's repository). Not bundled here to keep ShareAlike material out of the MIT code tree; download the items and place them in INSTRUMENTS_LOCAL_DIR/koerber_tia.json. The English version is not yet validated.
notes: The manual recommends analyzing subscales separately. Items 5, 7, 10, 15, 16 are reverse-coded (mark them with "reverse": true in your local file).
